# Gallery Images

To add images to the gallery, simply place image files in this directory.

## Supported Formats

- `.jpg` / `.jpeg`
- `.png`
- `.gif`
- `.webp`

## File Naming

Use descriptive filenames that will be displayed as the image title:
- `plant-cell-microscope.jpg`
- `dna-double-helix.png`
- `butterfly-wing-patterns.jpg`

## Image Guidelines

- **Resolution**: Recommended minimum 800x800 pixels
- **Aspect Ratio**: Square images (1:1) work best
- **File Size**: Keep under 2MB for optimal loading

The gallery will automatically display all images in this folder.
